Subject: ACME discovery recap + Mutual Action Plan (please confirm owners/dates)

Hi Samir / Leah —

Great to meet earlier today — appreciate you walking through the integration priorities and the latency/cost targets for your patient search use case. Quick recap and the next steps I promised: 

- What we heard from ACME: primary goal is sub-200ms p50 for short queries, selective document retrieval for PHI-safe fields, and a 90-day retention policy.
- Redwood recommendation: start with a small evaluation (2 GPU nodes) using our optimized 8-bit runtime + prefix caching for the ad-hoc search flow.

Attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with the milestones we discussed (kickoff, data checkout, test window, acceptance criteria). Can you do two quick things so we can lock delivery?

1) Confirm the primary owners in your org and their email addresses (we put placeholders in column B).
2) Confirm target dates for the 2-week evaluation window (we suggested 2028-03-06 -> 2028-03-19).

I dropped a Google Doc version here so it’s easy to edit: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDeFgHIJK-map-v1

Attachment: ACME_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

If it’s easier, I can propose 3 calendar slots for a short sync to finalize owners — would you prefer that?

Thanks —
Diego
